instagram:
Tally integration is what most month-end reconciliations are missing. The bank statement gets printed, the Tally ledger gets printed, and someone in accounts goes line by line with a highlighter until the two agree. It takes days, and the one entry that doesn't match is always found last.

Fine Solves builds custom products for jobs like this one: the bank statement and Tally entries brought into one place, matching entries paired up on their own, and only the odd ones out left for your accounts team to review. Live in weeks.
